fieldNotes.truckGate: April-2025 Street View shows the whole truck yard enclosed by a chain-link perimeter fence with box trucks/trailers parked inside; the access driveway passes through a gate opening in the fence. Controlled entry confirmed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard-booth structure visible at the gate. As a small ~115k sq ft product-exchange DC (built 2023, leased Nov 2023), the gate is a remote/badge-controlled sliding gate.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no booth -> remote check-in (kiosk/badge/call-box).
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Access drive from Lawing Rd to the gated yard is short (~80 m), with room for only 1-2 trucks before the gate.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Single dock bank on the SW building face; ~9 doors estimated (0-10 band) — Frito-Lay route-truck/exchange operation, not a high-door DC.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A few trailers/box trucks parked in the small fenced yard; no dedicated drop-yard lot — dropArea 0-10.
fieldNotes.dropYard: False — no dedicated trailer-storage lot; only a small operational truck yard.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural — single building surrounded by woods on a wooded access road off Lawing Rd, edge of Forest City, NC.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Small parcel, ~5 acres of cleared/paved area within the wooded lot.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur — facility is a truck-only product-exchange DC.
